notes.title: Seventh Circle releases tomorrow at 6 AM Eastern!
notes.content:
HELLO, AND GET HYPE:

We're super happy to announce that Seventh Circle has been approved for release and will be dropping, as planned, tomorrow at 6 AM EDT. 

This game is the culmination of over a year and a half of hard, hard work, and we are so excited to finally get to put it out in the world. We think it is a sweet, fun, funny little game, and we think (and gosh, we HOPE) you're going to feel the same way.

If you haven't already, Kickstarter backers can access your Steam key through BackerKit, and claim it using the "Add A Game" button in the bottom left corner of your Steam library. Once you've done this and the game is released, you'll be able to install it right away!

A few things to keep in mind for the launch:


 Please rate and review the game on Steam, if you are able! Reviews help us drive sales and raise the game's profile, which will expand our resources for future projects, DLC, etc. Also, we want to know what you think!
 We encourage bug reporting, especially in this first week. Use this page on our website to let us know about ANY issues you encounter.  You can include multiple problems in a submission. We've done our best to test the game thoroughly, but it's intricate enough that there are probably things we missed. So let us know!
 Linux support is on the way, complicated only by my (Anne) being away from my home computer right now. I will be home after New York Comic Con, and at that point I can start testing on Linux and figure out the problem! I suspect it will be a quick fix, but I appreciate some patience on that front.
 Speaking of New York Comic Con, we will be there! October 3rd - October 6th, Artist Alley booth E26. Becca will be selling her usual fantastic wares, including 30+ enamel pins and new prints, some of which are Seventh Circle prints! And we will be selling some leftover Kickstarter merch, so if you ever wanted to grab more, now is a great time. We really love meeting Seventh Circle fans, so please stop by if you're gonna be there!
 HAVE SO MUCH FUN. Tell us about it. Tell your friends about it.


A couple other things: the remaining Kickstarter fulfillment items (the minicomic & commissions) are coming, but they have to fit into Becca's wild art schedule. Additionally, the fate of our Patreon is currently in limbo, but if that's something you still want to see, feel free to voice that to us! We value your opinions.

Ok, phew, I think that's it for now. We love and appreciate all of you.

Keep on being awesome,

Anne (& Becca)
